fixtures.name: sessionstart-binds
fixtures.notes: SessionStart binds the documented session ID. Bootstrap context opens no turn.

fixtures.name: sessionend-ends
fixtures.notes: SessionEnd closes the session. It never submits or accepts a result.

fixtures.name: userpromptsubmit-opens-turn
fixtures.notes: A submitted human prompt opens turn telemetry. waiting_user_submit launches depend on this event.

fixtures.name: stop-completes-turn-without-result
fixtures.notes: Stop is turn telemetry only; no candidate kind can submit or accept a result.

fixtures.name: stopfailure-stays-telemetry
fixtures.notes: A failed turn stays provider telemetry with no result implication.

fixtures.name: pretooluse-starts-tool
fixtures.notes: Tool input and local paths are dropped; only the bounded tool name crosses.

fixtures.name: posttooluse-completes-tool
fixtures.notes: Successful tool completion carries no outcome and no result.

fixtures.name: posttoolusefailure-marks-failed-outcome
fixtures.notes: Tool failure stays tool telemetry with a failed outcome; it is not a turn or run verdict.

fixtures.name: permissiondenied-stays-silent
fixtures.notes: Vendor-native permission dialogs are distinct from BFB attention requests and never become candidates.

fixtures.name: notification-stays-silent
fixtures.notes: Agent notifications are not turn activity.

fixtures.name: subagentstop-stays-silent
fixtures.notes: Subagent activity is not run-turn activity.

fixtures.name: precompact-stays-silent
fixtures.notes: Compaction binds no session and opens no turn.

fixtures.name: future-event-stays-silent
fixtures.notes: Unknown event names are ignored for forward compatibility instead of failing the stream.

fixtures.name: snake-case-shape-stays-silent
fixtures.notes: Payloads outside the documented camelCase contract name no event and stay silent; a known event with an undocumented session key fails closed instead.

rejections: SessionStart with a missing or malformed session identity fails closed instead of binding.
A known event with an undocumented session key fails closed instead of binding a guessed session.
Turn and tool events with missing or malformed session identities fail closed.
Duplicate keys, trailing data, non-UTF8, and oversize payloads fail closed.
Headless turn input has no supported surface: NormalizeTurn always yields nothing, so usage stays unavailable and is never estimated.
scope: Raw Grok hook stdin payloads to bounded L03 semantic candidates. Field names are the documented camelCase contract (hookEventName, sessionId). All identities are synthetic; local paths in inputs are dropped by the parser and never appear in candidates.
